285156552.description:
Porcelain Pipe Bowls European Hand Painted Raised Relief Gambrinus Lot of 3
This lot includes three porcelain pipe bowls from Europe, dating to the late 19th or early 20th century. Two bowls feature hand-painted designs with raised relief scenes: one depicts a bearded man in regal attire holding a goblet with the inscription 'Gambrinus', and another shows a man and woman in traditional clothing. The third bowl is plain white porcelain with a double stem design. The painted and relief details are intact. See photos for condition and details.
5 x 3 x 3 in
